purpose: Make video-game research pay rent by binding extracted mechanics to current FIELD hosts with explicit non-transfer residue and executable/contractual proof.
selection_gate: no new sovereign app without missing function

transfers.invariant: Re-entry may expose what is known plus an already-declared unresolved edge without creating a quest, priority or obligation.
transfers.implementation: FIELD / CATCH + ACT route cards derive MORE HERE from evolution.question, open_gaps, or unresolved field.exit_paths only.
transfers.proof_claim: Fresh browser root renders at least one MORE HERE knowledge-gap witness when current manifest routes declare one.
transfers.retirement: No extra store or route; if MORE HERE increases clutter without improving re-entry, delete the projection with no data migration.

transfers.invariant: A failed bounded attempt should return new evidence/residue or be recognized as duplicate churn; failure is not a blank reset.
transfers.proof_claim: Execution contract requires failure to emit evidence/residue or stop repeating the same attempt.
transfers.retirement: Contract remains only while it prevents duplicate blind retries.

transfers.invariant: When effects are predictable, expose affected addresses and reversible/irreversible boundary before authoritative commit; uncertainty stays visible.
transfers.proof_claim: Execution contract distinguishes preview/configuration from commit/effect.
transfers.retirement: No extra UI required when native host already exposes equivalent preview.

transfers.invariant: A proposal may carry rich configuration while remaining explicitly non-real and non-actuating until resources, authority and enactment arrive.
transfers.proof_claim: Execution contract names PROPOSED/GHOST as non-real and incapable of increasing world authority.
transfers.retirement: Ghost disappears when enacted, rejected, superseded or no longer addressable.

transfers.invariant: Temporary support exists to restore or unlock capability and should name the condition under which it can be removed.
transfers.proof_claim: Execution contract requires temporary support/helper surfaces to name a retirement condition.
transfers.retirement: This rule itself may fold into a more general lifecycle contract once enforced elsewhere.
